_source_extra.title: Mother Goddess
_source_extra.description: This is one of the mother goddess found from Harappa. It is a mould and wheel made cream-coloured figurine. The eyes are represented by flat pellets of clay, and the nose is pinched. The mouth is made of a narrow strip of clay and grooved along the middle to represent the lips. The body is plump and the figurine wears two necklaces, one of which is long, double stringed with a circular pendant which hangs down between the conical breasts.
